comparison.objective: Populate a power shelf to N+1 redundancy from rack load; candidate adjusts and validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Capacity reasoning and power-module insertion versus hex-key alignment, counterholding, collar tuning, set-screw locking, and guarded test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Installed shelf capacity satisfies N+1 versus two energy-qualified non-bottoming stops with no drift. PR body, specs, load formula, and failure thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Redundancy planning and module population are meaningfully different from dynamic mechanical commissioning.
